# http

**Tag**: http, network, protocols, web, networking

## 简介

A composable, multi-platform, Future-based API for HTTP requests.

## 官网

- 源码仓库: https://github.com/dart-lang/http/tree/master/pkgs/http
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/http
